Unmodified Arduino Core source, libraries, build/package scripts and licenses. The separately packaged per-chip precompiled SDKs are tracked independently below.

Actual GCC/binutils/newlib/picolibc tags, crosstool-NG recipe and fixed submodules retained. Windows wrapper embeds Rust compiler 05f9846 (1.86.0) and lazy_static 1.5.0 paths, matching the recipe; exact Rust source distribution includes its vendored standard-library dependencies. libc calls are cfg(unix), not Windows code; two compatible libc sources are retained as build-context extras. This is source inventory closure, not a byte-identical rebuild claim.

Windows archive inspected: C GDB launcher (gnu-debugger/windows), not the Unix Rust launcher. Exact GDB, dynconfig and wrapper source retained, plus pinned GMP/MPFR/MPC/Expat/ncurses/libiconv and Python 3.8-3.14 header source versions used by Dockerfile.win. Original build scripts include libiconv patches. No Python interpreter DLL is bundled in these GDB archives; it is an optional external debugger dependency, not required for ordinary compilation or serial flashing.

Windows build recipe in pinned .gitlab/ci/build.yml retains libusb 1.0.29, hidapi 0.14.0, libjaylink 0.3.1, jimtcl 0.83 and Windows-only zlib 1.2.11. Source archives and original build/patch scripts retained.

Original esptool 5.3.1 source and both flasher stubs retained. Frozen Windows executables use CPython 3.13.14. Seventeen Python distributions matched against official wheels: every included Python module compares equal after compiling with CPython 3.13 and normalizing only filenames; included native extensions match byte hashes. Exact versions and counts are in docs/evidence/windows-full-release-20261031/python-dependency-comparison.json. PyInstaller 6.11.1 matches all five loader modules and the upstream python-binary-action default at build time. CPython external sources, cryptography OpenSSL 4.0.1, PyYAML libyaml 0.2.5, and checksum-pinned Cargo dependencies for cryptography/tibs are retained. Original source/notice inventory is complete; no byte-identical rebuild of the signed EXEs is claimed.
Exact mkspiffs tag and its SPIFFS gitlink f5e26c4e933189593a71c6b82cda381a7b21e41c are retained with original build recipes/licenses.
Exact 4.0.2 source and its littlefs gitlink d01280e64934a09ba16cac60cf9d3a37e228bb66 are retained with original build recipes/licenses.

Arduino5 source is bcmi-labs/dfu-util commit 3a18dc1d, including Arduino detach and warning patches. configure.ac intentionally still identifies 0.11-arduino4, matching the executable. The release workflow uses arduino/crossbuild 0.2.2 (08cd49e6); its libusb 1.0.26 build recipe and full source match binary debug paths.
